name: FMC and More Minnesota 2025
information: ### There is no 3x3 at this competition! ##### This competition is **not recommended** for new competitors. It will only host Fewest Moves Challenge, 3x3 Blindfolded, and 6x6 and 7x7 solving. [Click here for other upcoming Minnesota competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=minnesota) ##### ____________________________________ Only 1 guest per competitor is allowed to enter the room to ensure we have enough space. Additional guests may relax in the library.
